_comment: Source for the 'things I've shipped' section. Edit this, then run python scripts/projects.py (the Charts workflow also runs it). featured -> animated cards; more -> compact table. metric is optional: only put real numbers here.

featured.name: GPT-2 Medium Instruct
featured.blurb: GPT-2 Medium (355M) fine-tuned on Alpaca for instruction following, with a custom PyTorch architecture.

featured.name: TinyStories GPT-2
featured.blurb: A full GPT-2 decoder in raw PyTorch, trained from scratch on TinyStories and loadable with HF transformers.

featured.name: MedQA TinyLlama
featured.blurb: TinyLlama-1.1B fine-tuned on 5k medical Q&A samples with QLoRA in 4-bit NF4.

featured.name: sql-mcp-server
featured.blurb: An MCP server that connects Claude Desktop to SQL Server, with SQL-injection protection.

featured.name: saarthi-cli
featured.blurb: A terminal AI chat app with persistent memory, streaming replies, saved sessions and multi-provider models.

featured.name: AWS Fraud Detection
featured.blurb: Real-time fraud detection on 284,807 card transactions: XGBoost on a SageMaker endpoint behind Lambda + API Gateway.

featured.name: Airline Satisfaction MLOps
featured.blurb: Reproducible XGBoost pipeline for passenger satisfaction: DVC + MLflow on DagsHub, CI, and a FastAPI service on EC2.

featured.name: Predictive Maintenance
featured.blurb: Forecasts industrial machine failures from sensor telemetry (AI4I 2020), tuned with Optuna. 0.97 recall.

more.name: Stock Prediction: LSTM vs GRU
more.blurb: GRU wins with **R² 0.87** and 25% fewer params

more.name: NER: BiLSTM + Word2Vec
more.blurb: 9-tag NER on CoNLL-2003 with a stacked BiLSTM tagger

more.name: Customer Churn Prediction
more.blurb: 7,000+ telecom records, LogReg + Random Forest with SMOTE: **79.7% accuracy**

more.name: Conversational RAG Chatbot
more.blurb: Multi-PDF chat with history, FAISS + LLaMA-3.3-70B on Groq

more.blurb: n8n + Telegram + Razorpay ordering with session memory

more.blurb: Python + T-SQL window functions on discount-driven losses
